description: Conditional on the recorded target-span-two routing, primitive binary ramification degrees four and five are automorphic; fourth-power and zero-minor boundaries add no counterexample leaf. Exact programs certify the encoded determinant and projective-incidence calculations, not global exhaustiveness.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an exact LaTeX location for every program-relevant defining claim. A locator records where the current statement and evidence boundary appear; it is not a proof-review status.

members.statement: Assume the Program 2 structural reductions place a quartic Keller map in the primitive coprime binary-pencil locus, with H4=(P,Q,0), P,Q in k[x,y]_4 coprime, R=(H3)_3 in k[x,y]_3, U=J(Q,R), V=J(P,R), W=J(P,Q), and r=deg gcd(U,V,W). If r is four or five, then the full Keller map is a polynomial automorphism.
members.title: Primitive Binary Ramification Four and Five Is Automorphic

members.statement: Assume the Program 2 target-span-two reductions and suppose a primitive coprime leading pencil contains a fourth power, normalized as H4=(x^4,Q,0) with x not dividing Q. The highest Keller equation routes the cubic and, when necessary, quadratic normal layers to an aligned pure-power, binary, or quadratic-source branch; under the recorded Program 2 inputs every resulting branch is automorphic or already excluded.
members.title: The Primitive Fourth-Power Locus Adds No Quartic Counterexample Leaf

members.statement: Assume the Program 2 binary target-span-two reduction. If one of U=J(Q,R), V=J(P,R), or W=J(P,Q) vanishes, including the separate case R=0, then the quartic Keller map is a polynomial automorphism. Consequently the ordinary common-ramification filtration may be applied only after these zero-minor boundaries are removed.
members.title: Zero-Minor Binary Quartic Boundaries Are Automorphic

source_treatment: The linked working manuscript has exact locations for every program-relevant defining claim on this page. This says where the claims are recorded, not that they have been independently verified.
